# Data Processing Pipeline
# Transforms raw sensor readings
# into a clean summary report
. | .readings
| map(select(. > 0))
| sort
| {min: .[0], max: .[-1], count: length}

# Extract student info
. | .name as $name
# Store the score for grading
| .score as $s
# Apply grade classification thresholds
| {name: $name, grade: (if $s >= 90 then "A" elif $s >= 80 then "B" elif $s >= 70 then "C" else "F" end)}

# Stage 1: Extract data
# from the input object
. | .records
# Stage 2: Scale each value
# and rebuild the objects
| map({name: .name, value: (.value * 0.9)})
| map(select(.value < 50))
| sort_by(.name)

. | .capacity as $cap | .loads | length as $count | map(.size) | add as $used | ($cap - $used) as $free | {capacity: $cap, count: $count, used: $used, free: $free, pct: (($used * 100 / $cap) | floor), per_item: (($used / $count) | floor), status: (if $free < 0 then "over" elif $free < ($cap / 10) then "critical" elif $free < ($cap / 4) then "warning" else "healthy" end), even_split: (if ($used % $count) == 0 then true else false end)}

. | .config as $cfg | .users | map(.age as $age | .role as $role | {name: .name, clearance: (if $role == "admin" then (if $age >= 30 then "top_secret" elif $age >= 25 then "secret" else "confidential" end) elif $role == "manager" then (if ($cfg | .strict) == true then "confidential" else "secret" end) else (if $age >= 21 and .active == true then "basic" elif $age >= 21 then "revoked" else "none" end) end)}) | sort_by(.name)

. | .data # raw input data
# Filter by minimum threshold
| map(select(.value >= 10))
| sort_by(.id) # sort by identifier
# Build clean output
| map({id: .id, val: .value})
. | .departments | map(.teams | map({dept: .dept, team: .team, members: .members | map(select(.email | test("@company\\.com$"))) | map(.name) | sort})) | map(map(select(.members | length > 0)))

. | .entries | map({id: .id, data: ((try (.json | fromjson) catch null) // (try (.backup | fromjson) catch null)), num: ((try (.val | tonumber) catch null) // (try (.alt | tonumber) catch null) // -1), keys: (try (.json | fromjson | keys | length) catch 0)}) | map(select(.data != null)) | map({id: .id, data: .data, num: .num, keys: .keys, kind: (if (.data | type) == "object" and (.data | has("name")) then "named" elif .keys > 0 then "rich" else "simple" end)}) | sort_by(.id)
. | .events | map(select(.timestamp >= 1000 and .timestamp <= 2000)) | group_by(.type) | map({type: .[0].type, count: length, users: map(.user) | unique | sort})

. | .items
# Multiply the two factors for each item
| map(.value * .weight)
# Compute summary statistics
| {total: add, count: length}

. | .records
# Group records by state
| group_by(.state)
# Build summary per group
| map({state: .[0].state, count: length, total: map(.value) | add})
# Sort by state name
| sort_by(.state)
. | .records | group_by(.group) | map({group: .[0].group, count: length, sum: map(.value) | add, tags: map(.tag) | sort | join(", ")}) | map(select(.count >= 2)) | sort_by(.group)

. | .tags # raw tag list
| map(ascii_downcase) # normalize case
# Remove duplicates
| unique
# Sort alphabetically
| sort
# Join into comma-separated string
| join(", ")
. | .text | split(" ") | map(ascii_downcase) | map(select(length > 2)) | unique | sort | join(", ")

. | .users
# Filter active users only
| map(select(.active == true))
# Sort alphabetically
| sort_by(.name)
# Extract just the names
| map(.name)
. | .users | map(select(.active == true)) | sort_by(.name) | group_by(.department) | map({department: .[0].department, count: length, members: map({name: .name, email: .email}) | sort_by(.name)})

. | .values
# Try to convert strings to numbers, default to 0
| map(try tonumber catch 0)
# Remove failed conversions (zeros)
| map(select(. > 0))
# Sort ascending
| sort
. | if .a then if .b then "ab" else "a" end else "none" end
. | if .items | length > 0 then .items | map(.name) | sort else "empty" end
